prompt: Create an original 120 second Celtic acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for travel montage, walking and urban exploration. Mood: moving, bright, relaxed. Instruments: fiddle, tin whistle, bodhran, harp. Style: lilting compound-meter dance and modal melody. Tempo approximately 116 BPM; E minor. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use a forward-moving motif and recurring short instrumental answers. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: A melancholic and elegant chamber folk piece featuring a prominent violin melody, supported by plucked strings and woodwind. The arrangement is delicate and flowing.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而优雅的室内民谣乐曲，以小提琴为主旋律，辅以拨弦乐器和木管乐器。编曲精致流畅。
